skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze supply and demand for transportation services in tourism, and manage transportation services by air, sea, rail, and road.
Apply knowledge to implement marketing and sales activities for transportation services at tourist destinations.
Practice skills in analyzing the business environment for transportation service companies.
Practice skills in leading and managing transportation service companies.
Analyze case studies related to transportation services in tourism.
Manage the quality of transportation services such as air, sea, rail, and road services.
Develop transportation products at tourist destinations.
Analyze customer demand for transportation services in tourism.
Analyze the economic, social, and environmental impacts of transportation services at tourist destinations.
